# 2.2.1 String

> Source: [MS-RDL] v20251031 — pages PDF 73–73.
> Extraction textuelle : les tableaux complexes et diagrammes vectoriels peuvent nécessiter le PDF source.

2.2.1 String
If the RDL format specifies an element or attribute as type String, it MUST be a valid UNICODE
string, as specified in [XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1 for xsd:string. Unless the value is explicitly
specified (such as when the element or attribute is not present), its value is interpreted as a null
value.
